entities.summary: Tak Matsumoto (b. 1961-03-27, Toyonaka) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Toyonaka and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
